outlets.name: visit.brussels
outlets.credible: Official Brussels-Capital Region tourism organisation; editorial POI, gastronomy and 'must-see beer bars' listings, in FR/NL/EN. Native authority for what the city presents to visitors.

outlets.name: be.brussels — Brussels-Capital Region
outlets.credible: Official portal of the Brussels-Capital Region; authoritative for civic/cultural facts such as the Comic Book Route.

outlets.name: UNESCO World Heritage Centre
outlets.credible: Naming authority for the Grand-Place (857), the Major Town Houses of Victor Horta (1005) and the Ancient Beech Forests / Sonian Forest (1133). Lone-authority level.

outlets.name: Le Guide Michelin Belgique/Luxembourg
outlets.credible: Institutional gastronomic authority; a star, a Bib Gourmand or an inclusion in the selection clears the source bar on its own.

outlets.name: Gault&Millau België/Belgique
outlets.credible: Leading Belgian restaurant guide (scores /20, toques); credible for restaurant merit and chocolatier ratings.

outlets.name: RTBF (Radio-Télévision belge francophone)
outlets.credible: Belgian French-language public broadcaster; credible native editorial (e.g. its guide to essential Brussels beer bars).

outlets.name: BX1 (Brussels regional TV/news)
outlets.credible: Brussels' regional French-language news channel; credible for local restaurant, closure and cultural news.

outlets.name: La Libre Belgique
outlets.credible: Major Belgian French-language daily; credible food/lifestyle and news editorial (Michelin coverage, restaurant moves).

outlets.name: Le Soir
outlets.credible: Belgium's leading French-language daily; credible editorial (used as corroboration for Sainte-Catherine seafood).

outlets.name: La DH / DH Les Sports+ (La Dernière Heure)
outlets.credible: Belgian French-language daily; credible for food news (Michelin Bib Gourmand, restaurant relocations).

outlets.name: L'Avenir
outlets.credible: Belgian French-language regional daily; published the full Michelin 2026 starred/Bib list by province.

outlets.name: Le Vif Weekend
outlets.credible: Weekend/lifestyle arm of Le Vif; credible curated editorial on authentic Belgian/Brussels dining.

outlets.name: Le blog de Gilles Pudlowski
outlets.credible: Long-standing, widely published French food critic (Pudlo guides); named-authority corroboration for a specific restaurant piece.

outlets.name: Fodor's Travel
outlets.credible: Established international travel-guide publisher with vetted restaurant reviews; credible reuse where it names a place.

outlets.name: Petit Futé
outlets.credible: French editorial city-guide publisher with curated restaurant listings; credible (not user-review) reuse.

outlets.name: Le Fooding
outlets.credible: Influential French/Belgian editorial dining guide; credible restaurant selection.

outlets.name: Jeune Afrique
outlets.credible: Leading pan-African magazine; authoritative editorial on Brussels' African/Matongé dining ('cinq adresses incontournables').

outlets.name: Travel Tomorrow
outlets.credible: Brussels-based English travel news outlet; credible reuse (African-restaurants feature) as corroboration.

outlets.name: AFAR Media
outlets.credible: Established US travel magazine with editorial place recommendations; credible reuse where it names a place.

outlets.name: Atlas Obscura
outlets.credible: Editorial site for notable/unusual places; credible reuse (Atomium).

outlets.name: Le Routard
outlets.credible: Major French travel-guide publisher; credible editorial POI descriptions (Koekelberg, Schaerbeek).

outlets.name: Brussels Museums
outlets.credible: Official federation of Brussels museums; authoritative museum facts and addresses.

outlets.name: Museum Pass Musées
outlets.credible: National museum-pass organisation; credible museum listings/addresses.

outlets.name: urban.brussels / heritage.brussels
outlets.credible: Official Brussels-Capital heritage inventory; authoritative for protected monuments (Royal Greenhouses, Chinese Pavilion).

outlets.name: Admirable Façades / Art Nouveau Brussels
outlets.credible: Brussels Art Nouveau heritage inventory; authoritative facade documentation (Maison Saint-Cyr).

outlets.name: Commune d'Anderlecht
outlets.credible: Official municipal site; authoritative for Anderlecht's museums (Maison d'Érasme, Béguinage).

outlets.name: BrusselsLife.be
outlets.credible: Brussels city magazine with editorial features (e.g. its micro-breweries piece); credible as corroboration.

outlets.name: Brussels Express
outlets.credible: Brussels English-language local news outlet; credible reuse (Maison Antoine feature).

outlets.name: Good Food Brussels (Bruxelles Environnement)
outlets.credible: Official Brussels-Capital 'Good Food' programme directory; credible venue corroboration.

outlets.name: Wikipedia (FR/EN)
outlets.credible: Used only as a second, corroborating reference alongside a credible/institutional source — never as the lone recommender.
